- Set throughput targets (25 RPS sustained) and latency SLOs (95th < 450ms)
- Review prompt playback and routing fallbacks

Thanks — adding a couple of practical notes before the kickoff:

- Test harness: we will use the YAML config attached (load_harness_config.yaml) — it contains two steady-state windows: ramp (5m), steady (20m), ramp-down (2m).
- Tokenization & prompt playback: bring 10 representative prompt batches (we can replay on the harness). Please include any system & user prefix variants.
- KV cache warmup: expect a 3–5 minute warmup for persistent contexts; we’ll schedule a short warm-up run before the measured window.

Question for Dataflow: do you want us to route to a quantized variant for cost/latency comparison or keep everything on the highest-accuracy model? Either is fine, but we should decide before the workshop.

Attaching: load_harness_config.yaml
